summary: 問題設定がAIの作りやすさへ歪む問題には既知の技術的remedyがなく、A01-001(明確化フェーズ)とA13-001(決定記録)で仮定と決定を可視化した上で、product/ownership判断として人間が問題設定を裁定する。

evidence.summary: verification tax・expertise paradox等は扱うが、問題設定の歪み自体への対策は示していない
20,574 sessionで意図解釈の不一致が主要失敗形態の一つ。上流の問題設定を人間が保持する必要性の間接根拠

problem-framing-canvas (public, reputation established): read SKILL.md (skills/problem-framing-canvas/SKILL.md): the MITRE Problem Framing Canvas is run in three phases (Look Inward / Look Outward / Reframe); its stated purpose is 'to ensure you're solving the right problem before jumping to solutions - avoiding confirmation bias, overlooked stakeholders, and solution-first thinking', and the Input section asks the framer to name the solution everyone is anchored on so the canvas can 'de-bias it'.

applies_when: 新機能や仕様の起案にAIを使う
AI生成の設計書が権威的に扱われがち
not_applicable_when: 問題設定が人間の明示的決定として既に固定されている

expected_effect.primary: AI都合の問題設定を人間の決定として明示化し、後から再判断できるようにする
metrics: 決定記録に問題設定の理由が残る割合

known_failure_modes: AI生成specをそのまま採用し仮定が仕様化する(A08)
revalidate_when: A15に関する研究・公式guidanceの出現

existing_asset.confirmed_by: read SKILL.md (skills/problem-framing-canvas/SKILL.md): the MITRE Problem Framing Canvas is run in three phases (Look Inward / Look Outward / Reframe); its stated purpose is 'to ensure you're solving the right problem before jumping to solutions - avoiding confirmation bias, overlooked stakeholders, and solution-first thinking', and the Input section asks the framer to name the solution everyone is anchored on so the canvas can 'de-bias it'.
matched_on: human-led framing session run before any solution work
Look Inward phase surfaces the framer's own assumptions and the solution everyone is already anchored on
output is a human-authored problem statement / How-Might-We, explicitly 'not a solution brainstorm'
